create_dynamic_loss_scaler: create a DynamicLossScaler instance with custom init_scale, scale_factor, and tolerance parameters
scale_outputs_with_loss_scale: scale model outputs by multiplying them with the current loss_scale value
update_loss_scale_periodically: update the loss scale every scale_window iterations by multiplying it with scale_factor
check_gradient_overflow: check if gradient norm contains inf or nan values and adjust loss scale accordingly
decrease_loss_scale_on_overflow: decrease the loss scale by dividing it with scale_factor when overflow tolerance is exceeded
